rows.quote: Two days later Chase froze my entire account without any notice.

rows.quote: They said because I authorized the transfer there is nothing they can do.
rows.speaker: narrative
rows.driver: reported within an hour; told nothing can be done because the customer authorized the Zelle transfer

rows.quote: it sends me straight back to the login screen
rows.speaker: narrative

rows.quote: I was charged an annual fee of $95.00 after the agent told me on XX/XX/XXXX that it would be waived at renewal.
rows.speaker: narrative

rows.quote: I asked for a copy of that documentation and was told they cannot share it.
rows.speaker: narrative
rows.driver: reversal justified by merchant documentation the bank refuses to show

rows.quote: I called three times and got three different explanations
rows.speaker: narrative

rows.quote: Nobody will tell me why the account was closed.

rows.quote: Each time they agree it was their error, and each time the correction never happens.

rows.speaker: narrative
